Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
I am obliged for the [cheque](/topic/160) which came safely this morning.
My dear [Mother](/person/1606) died on Monday, the end coming much more suddenly than we had expected - and very mercifully to close the long course of feebleness of mind and body.
I do not think that I shall be able to do much steady work for some weeks to come, but after that, I hope to return to regular ways

Yours truly

C M Yonge
